text:
sarah: Heads up — hitting a 404/403 in the onboarding KB on the runtime quickstart, step 2 image. Can someone owning onboarding take a look? https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#step-2

ben: Can you paste the exact URL that's 404?

sarah: Sure: https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/quickstart#step-2-s3-assets
I ran a quick check:```bash
curl -I https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/onboarding/step2.png
HTTP/2 403
```

liam: Looks like CDN returning 403 (auth) rather than a 404. Could be a token/ACL rotation. cc @oliver infra.

oliver: I'll check CDN ACLs now. If it's a permissions regression we can re-deploy a fix. In the meantime can we put a placeholder image in the doc so it doesn't look broken?

maya: I can open a tiny PR with a placeholder + note. Will do a quick edit and mark it as temp.

ben: Please add an HTML comment like `<!-- temp-placeholder:2026-03-20 -->` so we can search for temp fixes later.

maya: Done and pushed: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8734 - small change, adds placeholder image and a note about pending CDN fix.

docs-bot: PR #8734 created and requested reviewers: @ben.

ben: Reviewing now. tiny nits only.

ben: LGTM, merging. :shipit: :thumbsup:

sarah: Thanks y'all. Follow-up: who owns runtime/quickstart long-term? want to add to OWNERS so this doesn't slip.

maya: Pinging @liaison for product/owner handoff.

liaison: I'm the custodian for onboarding content. I'll add runtime/quickstart to the owners file and open a follow-up to rehost the image on the new CDN (ticket DOCS-212).

oliver: I opened an infra ticket INF-987 to investigate the CDN ACL rotation and will update DOCS-212 with status.

sarah: Great — closing the loop here. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

ben: If anyone sees more broken assets from the recent deploy please drop them here or tag infra.

maya: noted, will run a quick link-scan for related assets and report back tomorrow.

sarah: :raised_hands:
